Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.qov.ph s. 20!-4- DILG OPINION NO. og HON. RINA E. QUINO Sangguniang Bayan Member Manolo Fortich, Bukidnon Dear Hon. Quino: This has reference to your earlier letter requesting the Departments legal opinion conceming the transfer of local govemment site without prior Resolution or Ordinance from the Sangguiang Bayan of Manolo Fortich, as provided for in Section II of R.A. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Govemment Code (LGC). Per your representation, the 1926 municipal hall stands in Barangay Tankulan, Sayre Highway, Manolo Fortich, Bukidnon, where it once served as the center of activity and govemance. You represented that sometime in the early 2000s, the Local Govemment of Manolo Fortich decided to construct a new Govemment Center in Kalanawan, Tankulan, Manolo Fortich in order to facilitate the growing number of its population. You then stated that in 2006, then Congressman of the First District of Bukdinon, Nereus O. Acosta, initiated the transfer of the seat of govemance of the Municipality of Manolo Fortich to the newly constructed Govemment Center which is being used by the said municipality up to the present. You also represented that you prepared an Ordinance declaring the Old Municipal Hall as a Heritage and Cultural Center in view of its historical significance in the Municipality of Manolo Fortich. However, during the committee hearing, it was discovered that there was no record from the Sangguniang Bayan or from the Municipal Planning and Development office of any Resolution or Ordinance to affect the transfer of the govemment site to other location. Thus, you are requesting for the legal opinion on the following: 1. Will the issuance of a Municipal Ordinance rectify an alleged "oversight" made without malice 17 years ago, as regards the transfer of the municipal site to other location? 2. Will there be any legal impediment in converting the old Municipal Hall to be a heritage and cultural center of the municipality? As to the first query, we answer in the negative. Section 11 of the LGC specifically reads: "Section 11. Selection and Transfer of Local Govemment Site, omces and "Matino, Mahusay at Masahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54



Facilities. — (b) When conditions and developments in the local govemment unit concemed have significantly changed subsequent to the establishment of the seat of qovemment. its sanqqunian may. after public hearing and bv a vote of two-thirds (2/3) of all its members. transfer the same to a site better suited to its needs. Provided, however, That no such transfer shall be made outside the territorial boundaries of the local government unit concerned. The old site, together with the improvements thereon, may be disposed of by the sale or lease or converted to such other use as the sangguniang concerned may deem beneficial to the local govemment unit concemed and its inhabitants. (c) Local govemment offices and facilities shall not be transferredl relocated. or converted to other uses unless public hearings are first conducted for the purpose and the concurrence of the majority of all the members of the sanggunian concerned is obtained." (Emphasis supplied) From the foregoing, the seat of the govemment shall be transferred only after public hearing and by a vote of 2/3 of all the members of the Sangguniang Bayan of Manolo Fortich. The absence of these requirements means that the transfer of the seat of the govemment is legally infirmed. Subsequent recognition through an ordinance of such transfer of the seat of govemment by the Sangguniang Bayan will not validate the same.l As to the we likewise answer in the negative. The old Municipal hall can be converted into a heritage and cultural center of the municipality, without legal impediment, as long as the municipality complies with the requirements laid in R.A. 10066, otherwise known as the National Heritage Act of 2009. The Municipality's failure to comply with the requirements for transferring the seat of the govemment will have no effect on the conversion of the old Municipal hall into a heritage and cultural center of the municipality of Manolo Fortich. This opinion shall be without prejudice to any contrary opinion rendered by more competent authorities and/or the courts. We hope to have addressed your concem accordingly. Thank you.
